english.title: Importer fail to take appropriate action in relation to non-conforming category F1/F2/F3 firework
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an importer who considered or had reason to believe that a category

(A)_[F1]_
(B)_[F2]_
(C)_[F3]_

firework which you had placed on the market was not in conformity with Part 2 of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015, failed to immediately take the corrective measures necessary to bring it into conformity, withdraw or recall it
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 22(1), 62(2)(i) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) does not apply (i.e. not a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is triable either way - see offence document H12332 (CJS code PA15095)
